components.name: fregs-density

config_status.grow_grad2d: calibrated (Gaussian-count matched vs gsplat baseline on bicycle/garden/room training logs); 0.0003 is the assumed pre-calibration default (~1.5x 3DGS 0.0002, Fig. 2 gradient ratio)

components.notes: Wraps gsplat DefaultStrategy; all other DefaultStrategy defaults (refine 500-15000/100, reset 3000) unchanged

components.name: photometric
components.status: unchanged (L1 + 0.2 D-SSIM whole run, paper Sec 4.1)

config_status.w_l: calibrated (train views): mean|d(L_photo+L_f)/drgb| = 1.7x photometric at step-1 state (Fig. 2, iter 0); median over 9 scenes; 2e-6 is a placeholder
config_status.w_h: calibrated (train views): ratio 2.0 at t=T full band on baseline-checkpoint renders of training views (Fig. 2, 12k-15k over-recon); placeholder = w_l
config_status.d0_frac: assumed (low band = global structure, ~0.8% of bins)
config_status.t0: assumed (>500 densify start; first opacity reset / SH degree 3)
config_status.t_end: assumed, bounded by paper (T <= 15000 since FR stops at 15000)
config_status.radius_units: assumed (origin at (H/2,W/2), index units, D = corner radius)
config_status.phase: assumed (Eq. 6 literal, no wrap; arctan read as atan2)

probes.name: freq-oracle
probes.measures: L_f value and d L_f/d rgb vs independent float64 explicit-DFT-matrix oracle with independently built masks (steps <=T0 and in (T0,T), odd sizes); identical images => 0 loss/grad

probes.name: freq-annealing
probes.measures: known-frequency sinusoid at D0<r*<D invisible for t<=T0 and while D_t<r*, visible once D_t>=r*; annulus bin counts vs independent count; low sinusoid visible at t=1; L_f==0 (graph-attached) at t=15001

probes.name: fregs-threshold
probes.measures: density spec grow_grad2d == calibrated > 0.0002, refine_stop_iter 15000; fixture with avg grad in (0.0002, grow_grad2d) does not grow, while base DefaultStrategy does

probes.name: fregs-gradient-gain
probes.measures: tiny synthetic scene: mean|dL/drgb| and mean||dL/dmeans2d|| ratio (photometric+L_f vs photometric) > 1.2 (Fig. 2 mechanism)

contributions.name: frequency-annealing
contributions.paper: Sec 3.3 (D_t band, piecewise L_f) + Sec 4.1 stop at 15000
